limitations: The mode setter, its configuration/rate/event/dump callees, every register accessor and the SPI callbacks execute in the sensor-hub emulator; the SPI transfer helper, memcpy, delay, logger and event post are supplied. Register reads return authored bytes (zero except the dump).
The globals are authored per case, starting from their original image values. Which callers invoke the mode setter, and when, is not executed here.

The two 380-pair embedded-function programs (FUNC_CFG_ACCESS/PAGE_SEL/PAGE_ADDRESS/PAGE_VALUE writes, FSM enable) are identified and hashed but not executed or redistributed; the image default selector (8) is invalid and cleared, so they are not loaded unless a caller sets 5 or 6.

Ghidra 12.1.2 RV32 SLEIGH computes fcvt.wu.s into a temporary and never writes rd; the runner repairs the single site 0x80f701a8 with RISC-V semantics (round toward zero, saturating) and records it as a fix action. A step trace confirmed the dropped write.
Nothing drives a real LSM6DSO; electrical timing and the fitted part remain unproved.

odr_event.value: (u32)(trimmed ODR * 100); 0 for accel-only enables unless selector 2

meaning.program: embedded-function program selector; 8 is invalid -> cleared, 5/6 select a program
meaning.state: last enable kind (2 gyro, 1 accelerometer only)
